name: Concurrent Metrics Increment Race Condition
ground_truth_root_cause: AsyncMetricsCounter increments self._counts dictionary across multiple threads without a threading.Lock mutex, resulting in lost updates due to concurrent read-modify-write collisions.
ground_truth_fix: Add a threading.Lock() mutex to AsyncMetricsCounter and guard dictionary mutations inside with self._lock:.
expected_symptom: AssertionError: Race condition detected! Expected 100 increments, got 87 (or intermittent value < 100)

name: Class-Level User Session Cache Leak
ground_truth_root_cause: UserSessionCache defines _STORE as a class attribute (shared across all instances), so state written by test_session_isolation_a persists and contaminates test_fresh_session_count_b.
ground_truth_fix: Initialize self._store = {} as an instance attribute inside __init__, or add an autouse pytest teardown fixture that calls UserSessionCache.purge_all().
expected_symptom: AssertionError: Leaked state detected! UserSessionCache should be empty for new test, but found 1 entries

name: Hardcoded Sleep Timing Assumption in Background Worker
ground_truth_root_cause: Test assumes background job finishes within fixed time.sleep(0.05) (50ms), but BackgroundJobRunner worker duration is variable (40ms - 90ms), causing intermittent assertions under load.
ground_truth_fix: Replace hardcoded time.sleep(0.05) with an active polling retry loop with a generous timeout: while not runner.is_finished(job_id) and time.time() - start < 1.0: time.sleep(0.01).
expected_symptom: AssertionError: Timing flake! Job job_export_999 was expected to be finished within 50ms, but was still running.

name: Implicit Order-Dependent Database State
ground_truth_root_cause: test_delete_existing_order implicitly relies on test_create_order_step running first in the same pytest session. When run in isolation or shuffled, the record does not exist.
ground_truth_fix: Make each test self-contained by creating the target order inside a pytest fixture or within the setup of test_delete_existing_order.
expected_symptom: KeyError: 'Order ORD-777 not found in database'

name: Unmocked External Currency Exchange Network Call
ground_truth_root_cause: CurrencyExchangeClient attempts an unmocked live TCP socket connection to closed local port 59199 on fallback currency pairs, causing immediate ConnectionRefusedError (fixture was changed from 192.0.2.1:80 to 127.0.0.1:59199 to eliminate 21-second OS TCP timeout during eval runs; root cause category is unchanged).
ground_truth_fix: Mock socket.socket or patch CurrencyExchangeClient.convert with pytest-mock / unittest.mock to return deterministic conversion rates without live network calls.

name: Unclosed Temporary File Handle Descriptors
ground_truth_root_cause: LogChunkManager retains open file objects in self._open_handles without calling close() before unlinking. On Windows and OS file descriptor limits, unlinking an open file fails.
ground_truth_fix: Explicitly close file handles (h.close()) before attempting os.unlink(h.name), or use tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() context manager.
expected_symptom: AssertionError: Resource leak: temp file ... was not properly cleaned up (or PermissionError on file removal)

name: Naive vs Timezone-Aware Datetime Clock Comparison
ground_truth_root_cause: SubscriptionService compares datetime.now() (naive local clock) against a timezone-aware UTC datetime (datetime.now(timezone.utc)), causing TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes.
ground_truth_fix: Use datetime.now(timezone.utc) consistently across all calculations and ensure all timestamp inputs are converted to UTC before comparison.
expected_symptom: TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes

name: Unseeded Pseudo-Random Token Prefix Generation
ground_truth_root_cause: ApiTokenService randomly chooses initial characters from an alphabet containing '_' and '-', which violates format validation rules ~15% of runs.
ground_truth_fix: Separate prefix generation to only draw from string.ascii_letters, or explicitly seed the random generator / mock token generation in tests.
expected_symptom: AssertionError: Random token failure! Token '_...' failed format validation rules.

name: Leaked Environment Variable Mutation
ground_truth_root_cause: test_override_env_production mutates os.environ['APP_ENV'] = 'production' directly without restoring it in a fixture teardown or using monkeypatch, causing test_default_env_development to fail.
ground_truth_fix: Use pytest's monkeypatch.setenv('APP_ENV', 'production') or a context manager / fixture that restores original os.environ after test execution.
expected_symptom: AssertionError: Environment state contamination! Expected 'development' but got 'production'

name: Socket TIME_WAIT Port Collision (Hard Ambiguous Case)
ground_truth_root_cause: MicroRpcServer.start() launches a background thread (_serve) with variable asynchronous startup latency (5-20ms). The test's hardcoded time.sleep(0.01) before connect() is shorter than the worst-case bind latency, causing sporadic TimeoutError. The fixture was revised from a synchronous bind (which made the test always pass) to an async bind with jitter so the flakiness empirically reproduces (~60% failure rate under consecutive runs). The original TIME_WAIT / SO_REUSEADDR description in the initial seed was not observed to reproduce locally.
ground_truth_fix: Add a threading.Event() readiness signal inside _serve() and wait for it in start() before returning, or dynamically bind to port 0 (ephemeral port).
expected_symptom: TimeoutError: timed out (client connect before server socket is bound)
